definitions.name: G0B.MEAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V G0B.SUM V LENGTH DIV

definitions.name: G0B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0B.MEAN

definitions.name: G0B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: key of a Record with the largest value; first on ties

definitions.name: G0B.JOINSP
definitions.body: [ 'X' BIND ' ' X 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: join a Vector of words with single spaces

definitions.name: G0B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN

definitions.name: G0B.BYNAME
definitions.body: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD

solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V V G0B.MEDIAN SUB G0B.ABS G0B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.prose.longest: ' ' TOKENIZE 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.ledger.debtors: G0B.BYNAME 'B' BIND B KEYS B VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E ZIP 1 GET -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
